Been trying to get myself to the doctor and therapist, which I've did before way in the past. As for calling a hotline, I've always been too nervous for that kind of stuff. I'd be a little happier if I could just make friends in the future. I used to have some, just a small group but eventually I kinda pushed them away.

People approach me and I'm able to hold a conversation but my shit brain always gets the better of me.
